name: continuity-columns
description: Three labelled columns over a timeline rule, with a closing line. Live: .apx-oc on /asset-intelligence-platform/.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient (must appear in title).

rule_svg.description: Inline SVG of the timeline rule under the columns.
